Agentview back-project samples on the cream cheese gave median xy around [-0.079,-0.246]. Wrist view over the basket rejected the previous far outside-lip target and measured the liner/interior center around x≈-0.01,y≈0.258.

cream_cheese_pi0_pick_step3.visual_check: wrist showed the blue-white cream cheese box held between the fingers

strategy_notes: From step 0, localize the cream cheese by RGB label in agentview and localize the basket by wrist-confirming the true white liner center. Move over the basket center for wrist refinement, then move to the cream-cheese pre-position [-0.085,-0.238,0.16] with gripper open. Run pi0_pick with prompt 'pick up the cream cheese', max_chunks 20, lift_thresh 0.05, gripper_closed_thresh 0.06, and verify the held box from gripper gap and wrist image. Carry closed through [-0.10,-0.05,0.19], [-0.03,0.12,0.21], and [-0.015,0.255,0.19]. Descend slowly with gripper closed to [-0.015,0.255,0.125] using step_clip 0.006; termination fired during this descent before release.
